What Appen sells

Uses people to prepare and check AI training data. Its work includes speech data and AI programs that act in the physical world.

  • Frontier Alignment · Human data and evaluation for post-training (additional training to improve an existing model).
  • Agentic AI
  • Multimodal and Speech AI
  • Physical AI
  • Model Integrity
  • Research Services
